blocks.html_en: Speed limit - maximum throughput separately for download (inbound) and upload (outbound), in KB/s. 0 = no limit. Ping is small packets, so a speed limit barely changes it - to test the limit use a file download. A positive value always limits something: an extremely small limit (below 1 B/s) is floored to 1 B/s, it does not silently turn into "no limit".

sentences.en: Speed limit - maximum throughput separately for download (inbound) and upload (outbound), in KB/s.
sentences.zh: 速度限制 - 下载（入站）和上传（出站）的最大吞吐量，以 KB/s 为单位。

sentences.en: 0 = no limit.
sentences.zh: 0 = 无限制。

sentences.en: Ping is small packets, so a speed limit barely changes it - to test the limit use a file download.
sentences.zh: Ping 是小数据包，因此速度限制几乎不会改变它 - 要测试限制，请使用文件下载。

sentences.en: A positive value always limits something: an extremely small limit (below 1 B/s) is floored to 1 B/s, it does not silently turn into "no limit".
sentences.zh: 正值总是会限制某些东西：极小的限制（低于 1 B/s）会降低到 1 B/s，它不会默默地变成“无限制”。

blocks.html_en: Buffer - the capacity of the link buffer for a speed limit, in milliseconds (0 = unlimited buffer). It sets how much queueing delay may build up on a rate-limited link before it starts dropping the excess (bufferbloat). Without this buffer the token bucket could "run away" tens of seconds into the future: packets carried extreme delay, and raising the limit mid-session (e.g. a "link recovers" schedule step) had no effect, because the backlog swallowed every faster step. With an N ms buffer the delay is bounded to ~N ms, the excess goes as "Rate-limit drop" (a separate counter, not "Loss" nor "Buffer overflow"), and after raising the limit throughput recovers within ~N ms. Default 1000 ms. Active only with a download/upload limit or a schedule set.

sentences.en: Buffer - the capacity of the link buffer for a speed limit, in milliseconds (0 = unlimited buffer).
sentences.zh: 缓冲区 - 速度限制的链接缓冲区的容量，以毫秒为单位（0 = 无限缓冲区）。

sentences.en: It sets how much queueing delay may build up on a rate-limited link before it starts dropping the excess (bufferbloat).
sentences.zh: 它设置在开始丢弃多余的（缓冲区膨胀）之前，限速链路上可能会产生多少排队延迟。

sentences.en: Without this buffer the token bucket could "run away" tens of seconds into the future: packets carried extreme delay, and raising the limit mid-session (e.g. a "link recovers" schedule step) had no effect, because the backlog swallowed every faster step.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这个缓冲区，令牌桶可能会在未来几十秒内“跑掉”：数据包会带来极大的延迟，并且在会话中提高限制（例如“链接恢复”计划步骤）没有任何效果，因为积压会吞噬每个更快的步骤。

sentences.en: With an N ms buffer the delay is bounded to ~N ms, the excess goes as "Rate-limit drop" (a separate counter, not "Loss" nor "Buffer overflow"), and after raising the limit throughput recovers within ~N ms.
sentences.zh: 对于 N ms 缓冲区，延迟限制为 ~N ms，超出的部分将作为“速率限制下降”（单独的计数器，而不是“丢失”或“缓冲区溢出”），并且在提高限制吞吐量后，吞吐量会在 ~N ms 内恢复。

sentences.en: Default 1000 ms.
sentences.zh: 默认 1000 毫秒。

sentences.en: Active only with a download/upload limit or a schedule set.
sentences.zh: 仅在有下载/上传限制或设置时间表时有效。

blocks.html_en: Delay (ping) - Latency: how many ms to add to every packet. Jitter: random variation of the delay (+/- ms), which makes ping jump and reorders packets. Three things worth knowing:

sentences.en: Delay (ping) - Latency: how many ms to add to every packet.
sentences.zh: 延迟 (ping) - 延迟：为每个数据包添加多少毫秒。

sentences.en: Jitter: random variation of the delay (+/- ms), which makes ping jump and reorders packets.
sentences.zh: 抖动：延迟 (+/- ms) 的随机变化，导致 ping 跳跃并重新排序数据包。

sentences.en: Three things worth knowing:
sentences.zh: 值得了解的三件事：

blocks.html_en: (0) Ping rises by about twice the latency you set. The delay is added to every packet, and with the default two-way traffic filter that is both the request and the reply - so --latency 100 shows up as roughly +200 ms of ping (measured: --latency 200 took a loopback ping from under 1 ms to ~408 ms). Pick half the ping you want. Jitter does not double the same way: each packet draws its own value, so the wobble grows by about 1.4x, reaching 2x only at the extremes. The built-in presets are dialled this way - Satellite (geostationary) carries 340 ms and delivers the ~680 ms ping a real geostationary link has.

sentences.en: (0) Ping rises by about twice the latency you set.
sentences.zh: (0) Ping 上升大约是您设置的延迟的两倍。

sentences.en: The delay is added to every packet, and with the default two-way traffic filter that is both the request and the reply - so --latency 100 shows up as roughly +200 ms of ping (measured: --latency 200 took a loopback ping from under 1 ms to ~408 ms).
sentences.zh: 延迟会添加到每个数据包中，并且使用默认的双向流量过滤器（即请求和回复） - 因此 --latency 100 显示为大约 +200 毫秒的 ping（测量值：--latency 200 的环回 ping 从低于 1 毫秒到约 408 毫秒）。

sentences.en: Pick half the ping you want.
sentences.zh: 选择您想要的 ping 值的一半。

sentences.en: Jitter does not double the same way: each packet draws its own value, so the wobble grows by about 1.4x, reaching 2x only at the extremes.
sentences.zh: 抖动不会以同样的方式加倍：每个数据包都会提取自己的值，因此摆动会增长约 1.4 倍，仅在极端情况下才达到 2 倍。

sentences.en: The built-in presets are dialled this way - Satellite (geostationary) carries 340 ms and delivers the ~680 ms ping a real geostationary link has.
sentences.zh: 内置预设以这种方式拨号 - 卫星（对地静止）传输 340 毫秒，并提供真实对地静止链路所具有的约 680 毫秒 ping。

blocks.html_en: (1) jitter adds an independent random delay to each packet, so packets can overtake one another in the queue - jitter inherently reorders packets (a real network does the same). (2) Negative swings are clipped to zero, so when jitter is larger than latency the average added delay rises above latency itself (e.g. latency 0, jitter 50 ms gives ~half the packets with no delay and a mean of ~12 ms, not 0). When latency is larger than jitter the effect is negligible.

sentences.en: (1) jitter adds an independent random delay to each packet, so packets can overtake one another in the queue - jitter inherently reorders packets (a real network does the same).
sentences.zh: (1) 抖动为每个数据包添加独立的随机延迟，因此数据包可以在队列中相互超越 - 抖动本质上会对数据包重新排序（真实网络也是如此）。

sentences.en: (2) Negative swings are clipped to zero, so when jitter is larger than latency the average added delay rises above latency itself (e.g. latency 0, jitter 50 ms gives ~half the packets with no delay and a mean of ~12 ms, not 0).
sentences.zh: (2) 负摆幅被截断为零，因此当抖动大于延迟时，平均添加延迟会上升到延迟本身之上（例如，延迟 0，抖动 50 毫秒给出约一半的数据包，没有延迟，平均值为约 12 毫秒，而不是 0）。

sentences.en: When latency is larger than jitter the effect is negligible.
sentences.zh: 当延迟大于抖动时，影响可以忽略不计。

blocks.html_en: Latency spike lives in the same section, because a spike is latency too - an occasional large one. With the given probability it appends extra delay (ms) to a single packet, which is how momentary "lag" actually arrives. The chance is per packet and applies in each direction, so a round trip hits it about twice as often as the number suggests.

sentences.en: Latency spike lives in the same section, because a spike is latency too - an occasional large one.
sentences.zh: 延迟峰值存在于同一部分，因为峰值也是延迟 - 偶尔会很大。

sentences.en: With the given probability it appends extra delay (ms) to a single packet, which is how momentary "lag" actually arrives.
sentences.zh: 在给定的概率下，它会向单个数据包附加额外的延迟（毫秒），这就是瞬时“滞后”实际到达的方式。

sentences.en: The chance is per packet and applies in each direction, so a round trip hits it about twice as often as the number suggests.
sentences.zh: 这个机会是针对每个数据包的，并且适用于每个方向，因此往返命中它的频率大约是数字建议的两倍。

blocks.html_en: Impairment (%) - Loss: percentage of packets vanishing without a trace (5% is already a clearly failing network). Corruption: percentage of packets with a flipped data bit - it affects only payload-bearing packets. Packets with no data (e.g. pure ACK, SYN) have nothing to flip, so they pass untouched and are not counted as corrupted. Duplication: percentage of packets sent twice.

sentences.en: Impairment (%) - Loss: percentage of packets vanishing without a trace (5% is already a clearly failing network).
sentences.zh: 损害 (%) - 丢失：消失得无影无踪的数据包百分比（5% 已经是明显出现故障的网络）。

sentences.en: Corruption: percentage of packets with a flipped data bit - it affects only payload-bearing packets.
sentences.zh: 损坏：具有翻转数据位的数据包的百分比 - 它仅影响承载有效负载的数据包。

sentences.en: Packets with no data (e.g. pure ACK, SYN) have nothing to flip, so they pass untouched and are not counted as corrupted.
sentences.zh: 没有数据的数据包（例如纯 ACK、SYN）无需翻转，因此它们会原封不动地通过，不会被视为已损坏。

sentences.en: Duplication: percentage of packets sent twice.
sentences.zh: 重复：发送两次的数据包的百分比。

blocks.html_en: Link flapping - cyclic total loss of traffic: every Period seconds the link is dead for the given percentage of the time. Simulates a flickering connection.

sentences.en: Link flapping - cyclic total loss of traffic: every Period seconds the link is dead for the given percentage of the time.
sentences.zh: 链路抖动 - 循环性总流量丢失：每个周期秒，链路在给定的时间百分比内失效。

sentences.en: Simulates a flickering connection.
sentences.zh: 模拟闪烁连接。

sentences.en: Advanced (NAT / connections):
sentences.zh: 高级（NAT/连接）：

blocks.html_en: • Target destination (IP/port) - impair only traffic to/from chosen servers. Both fields accept lists, ranges, CIDR, wildcards, comparisons, exclusions and regular expressions - see Filter syntax. E.g. IP 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50,!10.0.0.7, port 80,443,8000-8100. Empty = any.

sentences.en: Target destination (IP/port) - impair only traffic to/from chosen servers.
sentences.zh: 目标目的地（IP/端口）- 仅损害进出选定服务器的流量。

sentences.en: Both fields accept lists, ranges, CIDR, wildcards, comparisons, exclusions and regular expressions - see Filter syntax.
sentences.zh: 这两个字段都接受列表、范围、CIDR、通配符、比较、排除和正则表达式 - 请参阅过滤器语法。

sentences.en: E.g.
sentences.zh: 例如。

sentences.en: Empty = any.
sentences.zh: 空=任意。

blocks.html_en: • TCP SYN drop (%) - percentage of dropped connection-opening packets. Simulates a connection that will not establish (retry testing) - useful for tests from behind NAT.

sentences.en: TCP SYN drop (%) - percentage of dropped connection-opening packets.
sentences.zh: TCP SYN 丢弃 (%) - 丢弃的连接打开数据包的百分比。

sentences.en: Simulates a connection that will not establish (retry testing) - useful for tests from behind NAT.
sentences.zh: 模拟无法建立的连接（重试测试）——对于来自 NAT 后面的测试很有用。

blocks.html_en: • Max size (MTU) - drop packets larger than N bytes. Reproduces an "MTU black hole" from tunnels/VPN/behind NAT (small ones pass, large ones vanish). 0 = disabled.

sentences.en: Max size (MTU) - drop packets larger than N bytes.
sentences.zh: 最大大小 (MTU) - 丢弃大于 N 字节的数据包。

sentences.en: Reproduces an "MTU black hole" from tunnels/VPN/behind NAT (small ones pass, large ones vanish).
sentences.zh: 再现来自隧道/VPN/NAT 后面的“MTU 黑洞”（小黑洞通过，大黑洞消失）。

sentences.en: 0 = disabled.
sentences.zh: 0 = 禁用。

blocks.html_en: • NAT timeout - if a connection is silent for more than N seconds, the next inbound packet is dropped (the mapping "disappears"). A keep-alive test. 0 = disabled.

sentences.en: NAT timeout - if a connection is silent for more than N seconds, the next inbound packet is dropped (the mapping "disappears").
sentences.zh: NAT 超时 - 如果连接静默时间超过 N 秒，则下一个入站数据包将被丢弃（映射“消失”）。

sentences.en: A keep-alive test.
sentences.zh: 保活测试。

sentences.en: 0 = disabled.
sentences.zh: 0 = 禁用。

blocks.html_en: • TCP tear-down (RST) - percentage of connections abruptly torn with an RST packet. Forces reconnects. TCP only (RST is a TCP concept, UDP cannot be "torn" - use loss or link flapping). The Tear down TCP now button resets all active TCP connections for ~3 s.

sentences.en: TCP tear-down (RST) - percentage of connections abruptly torn with an RST packet.
sentences.zh: TCP 断开 (RST) - 使用 RST 数据包突然断开的连接百分比。

sentences.en: Forces reconnects.
sentences.zh: 力量重新连接。

sentences.en: TCP only (RST is a TCP concept, UDP cannot be "torn" - use loss or link flapping).
sentences.zh: 仅限 TCP（RST 是 TCP 概念，UDP 不能被“撕裂”——使用丢失或链路抖动）。

sentences.en: The Tear down TCP now button resets all active TCP connections for ~3 s.
sentences.zh: “立即断开 TCP”按钮会重置所有活动的 TCP 连接约 3 秒。

blocks.html_en: • Schedule - throughput that changes over time: time:download:upload in KB/s, comma-separated. E.g. 2:100:0, 2:500:0 = 2 s at 100 KB/s, then 2 s at 500, in a loop. When the schedule is non-empty it overrides the fixed "Download/Upload" fields - the GUI greys them out and says so explicitly.

sentences.en: Schedule - throughput that changes over time: time:download:upload in KB/s, comma-separated.
sentences.zh: 计划 - 随时间变化的吞吐量：时间：下载：上传（以 KB/s 为单位），以逗号分隔。

sentences.en: E.g.
sentences.zh: 例如。

sentences.en: 2:100:0, 2:500:0 = 2 s at 100 KB/s, then 2 s at 500, in a loop.
When the schedule is non-empty it overrides the fixed "Download/Upload" fields - the GUI greys them out and says so explicitly.
sentences.zh: 当计划非空时，它会覆盖固定的“下载/上传”字段 - GUI 会将它们灰显并明确说明。

sentences.en: Session:
sentences.zh: 会议：

blocks.html_en: • Duration (s) - after this many seconds the program stops itself (exactly as if you clicked STOP): impairment disappears, the driver is released. 0 = runs until STOP (the previous, default behaviour). The CLI equivalent is --duration. Like the traffic filter, it is taken into account only at START ("Apply changes" does not touch it). The value is saved in the config file and in the reproduction command.

sentences.en: Duration (s) - after this many seconds the program stops itself (exactly as if you clicked STOP): impairment disappears, the driver is released.
sentences.zh: 持续时间 - 经过这么多秒后，程序将自行停止（就像您单击“停止”一样）：损伤消失，驱动程序被释放。

sentences.en: 0 = runs until STOP (the previous, default behaviour).
sentences.zh: 0 = 运行直到停止（之前的默认行为）。

sentences.en: The CLI equivalent is --duration.
sentences.zh: CLI 等效项是 --duration。

sentences.en: Like the traffic filter, it is taken into account only at START ("Apply changes" does not touch it).
sentences.zh: 与流量过滤器一样，仅在开始时才考虑它（“应用更改”不会触及它）。

sentences.en: The value is saved in the config file and in the reproduction command.
sentences.zh: 该值保存在配置文件和复制命令中。

sentences.en: Repeatability and scenario:
sentences.zh: 重复性和场景：

blocks.html_en: • Seed - set any number so every run randomises the same way (a bug becomes reproducible). Empty = different every time.

sentences.en: Seed - set any number so every run randomises the same way (a bug becomes reproducible).
sentences.zh: 种子 - 设置任意数字，以便每次运行都以相同的方式随机化（错误变得可重现）。

sentences.en: Empty = different every time.
sentences.zh: 空=每次都不一样。

blocks.html_en: • Scenario - a JSON file that changes settings in real time (e.g. after 10 s add ping, after 20 s tear down). "Loop" replays it endlessly. Examples in scenarios/ (cafe Wi-Fi, mobile LTE->3G, congested VPN, failing DNS, overloaded game server, upload dropped midway, blocked backend/API).

sentences.en: Scenario - a JSON file that changes settings in real time (e.g. after 10 s add ping, after 20 s tear down).
sentences.zh: 场景 - 实时更改设置的 JSON 文件（例如，10 秒后添加 ping，20 秒后删除）。

sentences.en: "Loop" replays it endlessly.
sentences.zh: “循环”不断地重播。

sentences.en: Examples in scenarios/ (cafe Wi-Fi, mobile LTE->3G, congested VPN, failing DNS, overloaded game server, upload dropped midway, blocked backend/API).
sentences.zh: 场景/中的示例（咖啡馆 Wi-Fi、移动 LTE->3G、VPN 拥塞、DNS 故障、游戏服务器超载、上传中途丢失、后端/API 受阻）。

blocks.html_en: Profiles - ready presets sorted from best (top) to worst (bottom): Perfect network, Good Wi-Fi, 5G network, Home DSL (VDSL), LTE/4G, Satellite (low orbit), Distant server (another continent), Weak Wi-Fi, Cafe (crowded Wi-Fi), Congested home link (bufferbloat), Train/metro (tunnels), 3G network, Foreign roaming, Satellite (geostationary), In-flight Wi-Fi, 56k modem, Terrible network - plus your own (saved under a name). The program always starts on "Perfect network" (nothing is impaired until you set something). Built-in presets cannot be deleted - the "Delete" button is disabled for them.

sentences.en: Profiles - ready presets sorted from best (top) to worst (bottom): Perfect network, Good Wi-Fi, 5G network, Home DSL (VDSL), LTE/4G, Satellite (low orbit), Distant server (another continent), Weak Wi-Fi, Cafe (crowded Wi-Fi), Congested home link (bufferbloat), Train/metro (tunnels), 3G network, Foreign roaming, Satellite (geostationary), In-flight Wi-Fi, 56k modem, Terrible network - plus your own (saved under a name).
sentences.zh: 配置文件 - 就绪预设按从最佳（顶部）到最差（底部）排序：完美网络、良好 Wi-Fi、5G 网络、家庭 DSL (VDSL)、LTE/4G、卫星（低轨道）、远程服务器（另一个大陆）、弱 Wi-Fi、咖啡馆（拥挤的 Wi-Fi）、拥塞的家庭链路（缓冲区膨胀）、火车/地铁（隧道）、3G 网络、国外漫游、卫星（对地静止）、机上 Wi-Fi、56k 调制解调器、糟糕的网络 - 加上您自己的网络（以名称保存）。

sentences.en: The program always starts on "Perfect network" (nothing is impaired until you set something).
sentences.zh: 该程序始终在“完美网络”上启动（除非您设置某些内容，否则不会受到任何影响）。

sentences.en: Built-in presets cannot be deleted - the "Delete" button is disabled for them.
sentences.zh: 内置预设无法删除 - 其“删除”按钮已禁用。

blocks.html_en: Their numbers come from published measurements wherever measurements exist (Ookla medians for satellite and mobile, academic studies for Starlink's 15-second reconfiguration and for in-flight Wi-Fi). Where no such figure exists - "weak Wi-Fi" is not a measurable quantity - the comment next to the value in beantester/presets.py says so. A few of them are worth a sentence:

sentences.en: Their numbers come from published measurements wherever measurements exist (Ookla medians for satellite and mobile, academic studies for Starlink's 15-second reconfiguration and for in-flight Wi-Fi).
sentences.zh: 他们的数字来自已发布的测量结果（无论存在测量结果）（卫星和移动设备的 Ookla 中值、星链 15 秒重新配置和飞行中 Wi-Fi 的学术研究）。

sentences.en: Where no such figure exists - "weak Wi-Fi" is not a measurable quantity - the comment next to the value in beantester/presets.py says so.
sentences.zh: 如果不存在这样的数字 - “弱 Wi-Fi”不是一个可测量的量 - beanester/presets.py 中值旁边的注释如此说明。

sentences.en: A few of them are worth a sentence:
sentences.zh: 其中有几个值得用一句话来形容：

blocks.html_en: • Satellite (low orbit) - modelled on Starlink. Its steady state is good (about 40 ms of ping, 100 Mbit/s). What makes it distinctive is the reconfiguration every 15 seconds, which briefly stops transmission and shows up as an occasional latency spike rather than as loss.

sentences.en: Satellite (low orbit) - modelled on Starlink.
sentences.zh: 卫星（低轨道）- 以星链为模型。

sentences.en: Its steady state is good (about 40 ms of ping, 100 Mbit/s).
sentences.zh: 其稳定状态良好（大约 40 ms ping，100 Mbit/s）。

sentences.en: What makes it distinctive is the reconfiguration every 15 seconds, which briefly stops transmission and shows up as an occasional latency spike rather than as loss.
sentences.zh: 它的独特之处在于每 15 秒重新配置一次，这会短暂停止传输并显示为偶尔的延迟峰值而不是丢失。

blocks.html_en: • Distant server (another continent) - a fast link with nothing broken, just far away (~120 ms of ping). This is the one that exposes chatty protocols and code that assumes the server is next door.

sentences.en: Distant server (another continent) - a fast link with nothing broken, just far away (~120 ms of ping).
sentences.zh: 远程服务器（另一个大陆）- 快速链接，没有任何损坏，只是距离较远（约 120 毫秒的 ping）。

sentences.en: This is the one that exposes chatty protocols and code that assumes the server is next door.
sentences.zh: 这是公开的协议和代码，假设服务器就在隔壁。

blocks.html_en: • Congested home link (bufferbloat) - idle it looks fine (20 ms of ping). The impairment is the queue. ⚠️ It only bites once your application actually saturates the link, because the buffer is part of the speed limiter: send a trickle of test traffic and you will see a plain 8 Mbit/s down, 1 Mbit/s up link and nothing else. Saturate the 1 Mbit/s upload and watch ping climb towards two seconds - the "the video call dies when somebody starts a backup" case.

sentences.en: Congested home link (bufferbloat) - idle it looks fine (20 ms of ping).
sentences.zh: 拥塞的本地链路（缓冲区膨胀）- 空闲时看起来很好（20 毫秒的 ping）。

sentences.en: The impairment is the queue. ⚠️ It only bites once your application actually saturates the link, because the buffer is part of the speed limiter: send a trickle of test traffic and you will see a plain 8 Mbit/s down, 1 Mbit/s up link and nothing else.
sentences.zh: 障碍是队列。 ⚠️ 只有当您的应用程序实际使链接饱和时，它才会起作用，因为缓冲区是速度限制器的一部分：发送一小滴测试流量，您将看到一个简单的 8 Mbit/s 下行链路、1 Mbit/s 上行链路，没有其他内容。

sentences.en: Saturate the 1 Mbit/s upload and watch ping climb towards two seconds - the "the video call dies when somebody starts a backup" case.
sentences.zh: 使 1 Mbit/s 上传饱和，并观察 ping 值攀升至两秒 - “当有人开始备份时视频通话终止”的情况。

blocks.html_en: • Train/metro (tunnels) - the only preset that takes the link fully down for seconds at a time (3 s out of every 30), so the application has to reconnect, not merely slow down.

sentences.en: Train/metro (tunnels) - the only preset that takes the link fully down for seconds at a time (3 s out of every 30), so the application has to reconnect, not merely slow down.
sentences.zh: 火车/地铁（隧道） - 唯一一次使链路完全断开几秒钟（每 30 秒中有 3 秒）的预设，因此应用程序必须重新连接，而不仅仅是减慢速度。

blocks.html_en: • In-flight Wi-Fi - the classic satellite kind: ~750 ms of ping and 7% loss, which is the measured median, not a worst case. Aircraft with newer low-orbit equipment behave like "Satellite (low orbit)" instead.

sentences.en: In-flight Wi-Fi - the classic satellite kind: ~750 ms of ping and 7% loss, which is the measured median, not a worst case.
sentences.zh: 机上 Wi-Fi - 经典卫星类型：约 750 毫秒的 ping 和 7% 的丢失，这是测量的中值，不是最坏的情况。

sentences.en: Aircraft with newer low-orbit equipment behave like "Satellite (low orbit)" instead.
sentences.zh: 配备更新的低轨道设备的飞机的行为就像“卫星（低轨道）”。

blocks.html_en: A profile stores what the link is like: loss, corruption, duplication, latency, jitter, latency spikes, link outages (flapping), the speed limits and the buffer. Everything else - the target, the destination, blocking, RST, MTU, NAT expiry, the schedule, the seed - stays out of it. Saving a profile warns you about the ones you currently have switched on. Use "Save file..." for the complete configuration. Picking a profile or a preset sets all of those fields at once, including the ones a given preset does not mention - those go back to their default, so "Perfect network" really means perfect. Profiles saved by an earlier version load unchanged.

sentences.en: A profile stores what the link is like: loss, corruption, duplication, latency, jitter, latency spikes, link outages (flapping), the speed limits and the buffer.
sentences.zh: 配置文件存储链接的情况：丢失、损坏、重复、延迟、抖动、延迟峰值、链接中断（抖动）、速度限制和缓冲区。

sentences.en: Everything else - the target, the destination, blocking, RST, MTU, NAT expiry, the schedule, the seed - stays out of it.
sentences.zh: 其他所有内容 - 目标、目的地、阻塞、RST、MTU、NAT 到期、时间表、种子 - 都不参与其中。

sentences.en: Saving a profile warns you about the ones you currently have switched on.
sentences.zh: 保存配置文件会警告您当前已打开的配置文件。

sentences.en: Use "Save file..."
sentences.zh: 使用“保存文件...”

sentences.en: for the complete configuration.
sentences.zh: 以获得完整的配置。

sentences.en: Picking a profile or a preset sets all of those fields at once, including the ones a given preset does not mention - those go back to their default, so "Perfect network" really means perfect.
sentences.zh: 选择配置文件或预设会立即设置所有这些字段，包括给定预设未提及的字段 - 这些字段会返回到默认值，因此“完美网络”确实意味着完美。

sentences.en: Profiles saved by an earlier version load unchanged.
sentences.zh: 早期版本保存的配置文件加载时保持不变。

blocks.html_en: In the CLI (--preset) a preset can be given by its canonical id or a name in any UI language (case- and Polish-diacritic-insensitive - "Perfect network" works too). Ids: presets.perfect, presets.good_wifi, presets.5g, presets.dsl, presets.lte, presets.leo, presets.distant, presets.weak_wifi, presets.cafe, presets.bufferbloat, presets.metro, presets.3g, presets.roaming, presets.satellite, presets.inflight, presets.modem56k, presets.terrible.

sentences.en: In the CLI (--preset) a preset can be given by its canonical id or a name in any UI language (case- and Polish-diacritic-insensitive - "Perfect network" works too).
sentences.zh: 在 CLI (--preset) 中，预设可以通过其规范 ID 或任何 UI 语言的名称给出（不区分大小写和波兰语变音符号 - “完美网络”也可以）。

sentences.en: Ids: presets.perfect, presets.good_wifi, presets.5g, presets.dsl, presets.lte, presets.leo, presets.distant, presets.weak_wifi, presets.cafe, presets.bufferbloat, presets.metro, presets.3g, presets.roaming, presets.satellite, presets.inflight, presets.modem56k, presets.terrible.

The "Target process" field
sentences.zh: “目标进程”字段

blocks.html_en: A term can be a name or a PID - you can mix them in one field.

sentences.en: A term can be a name or a PID - you can mix them in one field.
sentences.zh: 术语可以是名称或 PID - 您可以将它们混合在一个字段中。

blocks.html_en: • A name (without * and without re:) works as a case-insensitive substring: chrome catches chrome.exe and chromedriver.exe. (It has always worked this way - kept on purpose so old configs and profiles still work.)

sentences.en: A name (without * and without re:) works as a case-insensitive substring: chrome catches chrome.exe and chromedriver.exe.
sentences.zh: 名称（不带 * 和 re:）用作不区分大小写的子字符串：chrome 捕获 chrome.exe 和 chromedriver.exe。

sentences.en: (It has always worked this way - kept on purpose so old configs and profiles still work.)
sentences.zh: （它一直以这种方式工作 - 有目的地保留，以便旧的配置和配置文件仍然有效。）

blocks.html_en: • A PID - a bare number (12345), a range (1000-2000) or a comparison (>1000).

sentences.en: A PID - a bare number (12345), a range (1000-2000) or a comparison (>1000).
Wildcard and re: match the process name.
sentences.zh: 通配符和 re: 匹配进程名称。

blocks.html_en: • Comparisons > < >= <= only make sense for a PID (numbers). >chrome is an error - the tool says so explicitly instead of silently matching nothing.

sentences.en: Comparisons > < >= <= only make sense for a PID (numbers). >chrome is an error - the tool says so explicitly instead of silently matching nothing.
sentences.zh: 比较 > < >= <= 仅对 PID（数字）有意义。 >chrome 是一个错误 - 该工具明确表示而不是默默地匹配任何内容。

blocks.html_en: All matching processes contribute their local ports - targeting covers the union of their ports. The port set is kept current during the session from the system's socket events, so newly opened connections of the process are caught as they open (without real WinDivert it falls back to re-scanning the socket table a few times a second).

sentences.en: All matching processes contribute their local ports - targeting covers the union of their ports.
sentences.zh: 所有匹配进程都会贡献其本地端口 - 目标覆盖其端口的联合。

sentences.en: The port set is kept current during the session from the system's socket events, so newly opened connections of the process are caught as they open (without real WinDivert it falls back to re-scanning the socket table a few times a second).
sentences.zh: 端口集在会话期间根据系统套接字事件保持最新，因此进程新打开的连接在打开时会被捕获（如果没有真正的 WinDivert，它会每秒重新扫描套接字表几次）。

blocks.html_en: What "its local ports" means in practice. A packet carries addresses and ports, never a program name, so the tool cannot match on "Chrome" directly. It looks up which local ports the process owns and matches every packet on its local port.

sentences.en: What "its local ports" means in practice.
sentences.zh: “其本地港口”在实践中意味着什么。

sentences.en: A packet carries addresses and ports, never a program name, so the tool cannot match on "Chrome" directly.
sentences.zh: 数据包携带地址和端口，而不是程序名称，因此该工具无法直接在“Chrome”上进行匹配。

sentences.en: It looks up which local ports the process owns and matches every packet on its local port.
sentences.zh: 它查找进程拥有哪些本地端口并匹配其本地端口上的每个数据包。

blocks.html_en: This is why 443 never shows up here. When Chrome loads a page, 443 is the server's port - Chrome's own end of that connection is a temporary port like 15597, and that number belongs to one process at a time, so its traffic is caught exactly.

sentences.en: This is why 443 never shows up here.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么 443 从未出现在这里。

sentences.en: When Chrome loads a page, 443 is the server's port - Chrome's own end of that connection is a temporary port like 15597, and that number belongs to one process at a time, so its traffic is caught exactly.
sentences.zh: 当 Chrome 加载页面时，443 是服务器的端口 - Chrome 自己的连接端是一个临时端口，例如 15597，并且该号码一次属于一个进程，因此可以准确捕获其流量。

blocks.html_en: A few ports work differently. mDNS (5353), SSDP (1900) and DHCP (67/68) are held by several programs at once, because that is how programs find devices on your network. There the port number no longer says whose traffic it is, so it is all or nothing: either everything on that port is impaired or nothing on it is. The log says so when it happens and names which of the two applies. Ordinary traffic is not affected.

sentences.en: A few ports work differently.
sentences.zh: 一些端口的工作方式有所不同。

sentences.en: mDNS (5353), SSDP (1900) and DHCP (67/68) are held by several programs at once, because that is how programs find devices on your network.
sentences.zh: mDNS (5353)、SSDP (1900) 和 DHCP (67/68) 同时由多个程序持有，因为这是程序在网络上查找设备的方式。

sentences.en: There the port number no longer says whose traffic it is, so it is all or nothing: either everything on that port is impaired or nothing on it is.
sentences.zh: 在那里，端口号不再表明它是谁的流量，因此要么全有，要么全无：要么该端口上的所有内容都受到损害，要么什么都没有。

sentences.en: The log says so when it happens and names which of the two applies.
sentences.zh: 日志在发生这种情况时会如此描述，并指出两者中哪一个适用。

sentences.en: Ordinary traffic is not affected.
sentences.zh: 正常交通不受影响。

sentences.en: A rule never matches an address from the other family - an IPv4 rule will not catch an IPv6 address and vice versa (you can safely mix them in one field).

sentences.en: Patterns are case-insensitive and look for a match anywhere (re.search) - if you want a start-to-end match, use ^ and $.
sentences.zh: 模式不区分大小写，并在任何地方查找匹配（re.search） - 如果您想要从头到尾匹配，请使用 ^ 和 $。

blocks.html_en: A comma inside a regex must be escaped with a backslash (\,), because a comma separates terms:

sentences.en: A comma inside a regex must be escaped with a backslash (\,), because a comma separates terms:
sentences.zh: 正则表达式中的逗号必须用反斜杠 (\,) 转义，因为逗号分隔术语：

blocks.html_en: Cases that trip people up

sentences.en: Cases that trip people up
sentences.zh: 让人绊倒的案例

blocks.html_en: • chrome also catches chromedriver, but chrome.exe does not. A bare name is a substring: the text "chrome" appears in chromedriver.exe, but the text "chrome.exe" does not (there it is chrome + driver.exe). So chrome.exe -> only chrome.exe. chrome -> chrome.exe and chromedriver.exe.

sentences.en: chrome also catches chromedriver, but chrome.exe does not.
sentences.zh: chrome 也会捕获 chromedriver，但 chrome.exe 不会。

sentences.en: A bare name is a substring: the text "chrome" appears in chromedriver.exe, but the text "chrome.exe" does not (there it is chrome + driver.exe).
sentences.zh: 裸名称是一个子字符串：文本“chrome”出现在 chromedriver.exe 中，但文本“chrome.exe”却没有出现（这里是 chrome + driver.exe）。

sentences.en: So chrome.exe -> only chrome.exe.
sentences.zh: 所以 chrome.exe -> 只有 chrome.exe。

sentences.en: chrome -> chrome.exe and chromedriver.exe.
sentences.zh: chrome -> chrome.exe 和 chromedriver.exe。

blocks.html_en: • chrome* is broader than it looks. The star is "any run", so chrome* catches chromedriver.exe exactly like chrome. Want exactly one app? Use re:^chrome\.exe$ or add an exclusion: chrome, !chromedriver.

sentences.en: chrome* is broader than it looks.
sentences.zh: chrome* 比看起来更广泛。

sentences.en: The star is "any run", so chrome* catches chromedriver.exe exactly like chrome.
sentences.zh: 星星是“任意运行”，因此 chrome* 捕获 chromedriver.exe 的方式与 chrome 完全相同。

sentences.en: Want exactly one app?
sentences.zh: 想要一款应用程序吗？

sentences.en: Use re:^chrome\.exe$ or add an exclusion: chrome, !chromedriver.
sentences.zh: 使用 re:^chrome\.exe$ 或添加排除项：chrome、!chromedriver。

blocks.html_en: • 8* in a port field is a wildcard on the number's text, so it catches 8, 80, 8080 and 8443 - but not 443. You almost always meant a range: 8000-8999. Use port wildcards deliberately.

sentences.en: 8* in a port field is a wildcard on the number's text, so it catches 8, 80, 8080 and 8443 - but not 443.
sentences.zh: 端口字段中的 8* 是数字文本上的通配符，因此它捕获 8、80、8080 和 8443 - 但不捕获 443。

sentences.en: You almost always meant a range: 8000-8999.
sentences.zh: 您几乎总是指一个范围：8000-8999。

sentences.en: Use port wildcards deliberately.
sentences.zh: 有意使用端口通配符。

blocks.html_en: • 80,443,!8080 is just 80,443. An exclusion that cuts nothing is not an error - it is simply useless.

sentences.en: An exclusion that cuts nothing is not an error - it is simply useless.
sentences.zh: 没有任何效果的排除并不是错误——它只是毫无用处。

blocks.html_en: • !53 also covers traffic with no port (e.g. ICMP/ping). "Everything except 53" literally means "everything that is not port 53", and an ICMP packet is not port 53. If you want only TCP/UDP, narrow the Traffic filter.

sentences.en: !53 also covers traffic with no port (e.g. ICMP/ping).
sentences.zh: !53 还涵盖没有端口的流量（例如 ICMP/ping）。

sentences.en: "Everything except 53" literally means "everything that is not port 53", and an ICMP packet is not port 53.
sentences.zh: “除了 53 之外的所有内容”字面意思是“端口 53 以外的所有内容”，ICMP 数据包不是端口 53。

sentences.en: If you want only TCP/UDP, narrow the Traffic filter.
sentences.zh: 如果您只需要 TCP/UDP，请缩小流量过滤器的范围。

blocks.html_en: • An empty term is an error, not "everything": 80,,443 and 80,! are rejected. An empty whole field means "everything".

sentences.en: An empty term is an error, not "everything": 80,,443 and 80,!
sentences.zh: 空术语是错误，而不是“一切”：80,,443 和 80,！

sentences.en: are rejected.
sentences.zh: 被拒绝。

sentences.en: An empty whole field means "everything".
sentences.zh: 整个字段空着意味着“一切”。

blocks.html_en: • IP and port combine with AND. IP=10.0.0.0/8 + port=443 means "traffic to the 10.x network and at the same time on port 443". Want "either/or"? Leave the other field empty and do two runs.

sentences.en: IP and port combine with AND.
sentences.zh: IP和端口用AND组合。

sentences.en: IP=10.0.0.0/8 + port=443 means "traffic to the 10.x network and at the same time on port 443".
sentences.zh: IP=10.0.0.0/8 + port=443 表示“流量流向 10.x 网络，同时在端口 443 上”。

sentences.en: Want "either/or"?
sentences.zh: 想要“非此即彼”吗？

sentences.en: Leave the other field empty and do two runs.
sentences.zh: 将另一个字段留空并运行两次。

blocks.html_en: • >chrome is an error. Comparisons work on numbers (PID), not names.

sentences.en: >chrome is an error.
sentences.zh: >chrome 是一个错误。

sentences.en: Comparisons work on numbers (PID), not names.
sentences.zh: 比较适用于数字 (PID)，而不是名称。

blocks.html_en: • 2000-1000 is an error (reversed range), not an empty set.

sentences.en: 2000-1000 is an error (reversed range), not an empty set.
sentences.zh: 2000-1000 是一个错误（范围反转），而不是空集。

blocks.html_en: • A wildcard is not a regex. In chrome* the star means "any run". In re:chrome* it means "the letter e repeated 0+ times". If you write re:, you write a regex.

sentences.en: A wildcard is not a regex.
sentences.zh: 通配符不是正则表达式。

sentences.en: In chrome* the star means "any run".
sentences.zh: 在 chrome* 中，星号表示“任意运行”。

sentences.en: In re:chrome* it means "the letter e repeated 0+ times".
sentences.zh: 在 re:chrome* 中，它的意思是“字母 e 重复 0 次以上”。

sentences.en: If you write re:, you write a regex.
sentences.zh: 如果你写 re:，你就写了一个正则表达式。

blocks.html_en: Every syntax error is reported immediately: in the GUI the field turns red with the reason beneath it (in the UI language), and the CLI ends with a readable error: ... - never a silent "nothing works".

sentences.en: Every syntax error is reported immediately: in the GUI the field turns red with the reason beneath it (in the UI language), and the CLI ends with a readable error: ... - never a silent "nothing works".
sentences.zh: 每个语法错误都会立即报告：在 GUI 中，该字段会变成红色，并在其下方显示原因（以 UI 语言），并且 CLI 以可读错误结束：... - 永远不会出现无声的“无济于事”。

sentences.en: Statistics (what the counters mean)
sentences.zh: 统计数据（计数器的含义）

blocks.html_en: The throughput chart has a Y axis with values (KB/s), a grid, a "nicely" rounded scale and current down/up readouts in the corner. Download/Upload (KB/s live), Packets (how many passed), Queued (waiting - grows with delay/limit), Lost, Corrupted, Duplicated, Buffer overflow (dropped when the tool is overloaded), Dropped at stop (were still queued when STOP was pressed), Send failed (the tool captured them but could not put them back on the wire - the connection went down, or the driver refused), Rate-limit drop (dropped by a full speed-limit buffer - counted separately from loss and from "Buffer overflow"), SYN dropped, MTU dropped, NAT expired, RST torn, LAN: internet cut off, RST sent.

sentences.en: The throughput chart has a Y axis with values (KB/s), a grid, a "nicely" rounded scale and current down/up readouts in the corner.
sentences.zh: 吞吐量图表有一个带有值 (KB/s) 的 Y 轴、一个网格、一个“漂亮”的圆形刻度以及角落中的当前向下/向上读数。

sentences.en: Download/Upload (KB/s live), Packets (how many passed), Queued (waiting - grows with delay/limit), Lost, Corrupted, Duplicated, Buffer overflow (dropped when the tool is overloaded), Dropped at stop (were still queued when STOP was pressed), Send failed (the tool captured them but could not put them back on the wire - the connection went down, or the driver refused), Rate-limit drop (dropped by a full speed-limit buffer - counted separately from loss and from "Buffer overflow"), SYN dropped, MTU dropped, NAT expired, RST torn, LAN: internet cut off, RST sent.
sentences.zh: 下载/上传（KB/秒实时）、数据包（通过的数量）、排队（等待 - 随着延迟/限制而增长）、丢失、损坏、重复、缓冲区溢出（工具过载时丢弃）、停止时丢弃（按下 STOP 时仍在排队）、发送失败（工具捕获它们但无法将它们放回线上 - 连接中断或驱动程序拒绝）、速率限制丢弃（被满限速缓冲区丢弃） - 与丢失和“缓冲区溢出”分开计算）、SYN 丢失、MTU 丢失、NAT 过期、RST 撕裂、LAN：互联网切断、RST 发送。

blocks.html_en: The last three of those - "Buffer overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" - are the tool losing your packets rather than the link you asked it to simulate. They are counted, they keep the seen/delivered/dropped arithmetic honest, and they are deliberately not part of "Effective loss". Any of them being non-zero means part of the loss you are measuring is ours.

sentences.en: The last three of those - "Buffer overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" - are the tool losing your packets rather than the link you asked it to simulate.
sentences.zh: 其中最后三个 - “缓冲区溢出”、“停止时丢弃”和“发送失败” - 是工具丢失数据包而不是您要求它模拟的链接。

sentences.en: They are counted, they keep the seen/delivered/dropped arithmetic honest, and they are deliberately not part of "Effective loss".
sentences.zh: 它们被计算在内，它们保持看到/交付/丢弃的算术诚实，并且它们故意不属于“有效损失”。

blocks.html_en: • Seed (effective) - even if you leave the Seed field empty, the program draws and remembers a concrete seed. Type it into the Seed field later and run again to get the same draws.

blocks.html_en: • Repeatable flapping - the link-outage pattern is measured from the session start, so with the same settings it repeats identically between runs (it does not depend on the system clock).

sentences.en: Repeatable flapping - the link-outage pattern is measured from the session start, so with the same settings it repeats identically between runs (it does not depend on the system clock).
sentences.zh: 可重复的摆动 - 链路中断模式是从会话开始开始测量的，因此使用相同的设置，它在运行之间以相同的方式重复（它不依赖于系统时钟）。

blocks.html_en: • What the seed reproduces - the seed reproduces the engine's decisions (which packets get dropped, corrupted, duplicated, by how much delayed), not the packet count. The traffic that crosses the link depends on what your apps and system do at that moment, so two runs with the same seed give the same proportions (e.g. 15.8% loss in both) but not identical counters to the packet. For CI comparisons use rates (%), not raw packet counts.

sentences.en: What the seed reproduces - the seed reproduces the engine's decisions (which packets get dropped, corrupted, duplicated, by how much delayed), not the packet count.
sentences.zh: 种子再现的内容 - 种子再现引擎的决策（哪些数据包被丢弃、损坏、重复，延迟了多少），而不是数据包计数。

sentences.en: The traffic that crosses the link depends on what your apps and system do at that moment, so two runs with the same seed give the same proportions (e.g. 15.8% loss in both) but not identical counters to the packet.
sentences.zh: 通过链接的流量取决于您的应用程序和系统当时执行的操作，因此使用相同种子的两次运行会给出相同的比例（例如，两次都丢失 15.8%），但数据包的计数器不同。

sentences.en: For CI comparisons use rates (%), not raw packet counts.
sentences.zh: 对于 CI 比较，使用比率 (%)，而不是原始数据包计数。

blocks.html_en: • Start / Duration / Effective loss / Queue peak / Down-up peak - a quick picture of the run.

sentences.en: Start / Duration / Effective loss / Queue peak / Down-up peak - a quick picture of the run.
sentences.zh: 开始/持续时间/有效损失/队列峰值/下降峰值 - 运行的快速图片。

blocks.html_en: • What "Effective loss" counts - the share of the traffic you aimed at that this tool broke, across every impairment: the configured Loss plus rate-limit drops, blocking, LAN cut, link outages, connection resets, SYN drops, MTU drops and NAT expiry. With a target set, only the target's traffic counts, so other applications cannot dilute it. Packets the tool threw away are deliberately excluded - "Buffer overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" are its own failures, not the link's, and they have their own counters. The report's effective_loss_pct is the same number, next to packets_in_scope.

sentences.en: What "Effective loss" counts - the share of the traffic you aimed at that this tool broke, across every impairment: the configured Loss plus rate-limit drops, blocking, LAN cut, link outages, connection resets, SYN drops, MTU drops and NAT expiry.
sentences.zh: “有效丢失”的含义 - 该工具破坏的流量所占的份额，涵盖每种损害：配置的丢失加上速率限制丢弃、阻塞、LAN 切断、链路中断、连接重置、SYN 丢弃、MTU 丢弃和 NAT 过期。

sentences.en: With a target set, only the target's traffic counts, so other applications cannot dilute it.
sentences.zh: 设置目标后，只有目标的流量才算在内，因此其他应用程序无法稀释它。

sentences.en: Packets the tool threw away are deliberately excluded - "Buffer overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" are its own failures, not the link's, and they have their own counters.
sentences.zh: 工具丢弃的数据包被故意排除 - “缓冲区溢出”、“停止时丢弃”和“发送失败”是其自身的故障，而不是链接的故障，并且它们有自己的计数器。

sentences.en: The report's effective_loss_pct is the same number, next to packets_in_scope.
sentences.zh: 报告的 effective_loss_pct 与 packet_in_scope 旁边的数字相同。

blocks.html_en: • Driver queue wait (peak) - the longest a packet had already been waiting inside WinDivert when this tool received it. It is measured, not estimated: the driver stamps every packet with a capture time, and the tool samples that 20 times a second. On an idle machine it is a fraction of a millisecond (measured here: 0.05-0.16 ms). If it grows, the tool is adding delay that shows up in no other counter, because it happens in the driver's queue ahead of its own - and above 50 ms it says so in the log and the event list. Blank on --simulate, which has no driver.

sentences.en: Driver queue wait (peak) - the longest a packet had already been waiting inside WinDivert when this tool received it.
sentences.zh: 驱动程序队列等待（峰值）- 当该工具收到数据包时，数据包已在 WinDivert 内等待的最长时间。

sentences.en: It is measured, not estimated: the driver stamps every packet with a capture time, and the tool samples that 20 times a second.
sentences.zh: 它是测量的，而不是估计的：驱动程序用捕获时间标记每个数据包，并且该工具每秒采样 20 次。

sentences.en: On an idle machine it is a fraction of a millisecond (measured here: 0.05-0.16 ms).
sentences.zh: 在空闲机器上，它是毫秒的一小部分（此处测量：0.05-0.16 毫秒）。

sentences.en: If it grows, the tool is adding delay that shows up in no other counter, because it happens in the driver's queue ahead of its own - and above 50 ms it says so in the log and the event list.
sentences.zh: 如果它增长，该工具就会增加延迟，而其他计数器中不会显示这种延迟，因为它发生在驱动程序队列中，先于它自己的队列 - 并且超过 50 毫秒，它在日志和事件列表中如此说明。

sentences.en: Blank on --simulate, which has no driver.
sentences.zh: --simulate 为空白，没有驱动程序。

blocks.html_en: • It measures this machine, not the internet. The tool sees packets crossing this computer's network stack, so a packet lost out on the network - the reply that never came back - never arrives here and nothing here can count it. A clean 30-packet ping that loses one reply shows 59 packets on the connection row and zero drops, and both numbers are right: 30 requests went out, 29 replies came back, and the tool broke none of them. End-to-end loss is what your application's own figures (or ping's "Lost") are for.

sentences.en: It measures this machine, not the internet.
sentences.zh: 它测量的是这台机器，而不是互联网。

sentences.en: The tool sees packets crossing this computer's network stack, so a packet lost out on the network - the reply that never came back - never arrives here and nothing here can count it.
sentences.zh: 该工具会看到穿过该计算机网络堆栈的数据包，因此在网络上丢失的数据包（从未返回的答复）永远不会到达这里，这里没有任何东西可以对其进行计数。

sentences.en: A clean 30-packet ping that loses one reply shows 59 packets on the connection row and zero drops, and both numbers are right: 30 requests went out, 29 replies came back, and the tool broke none of them.
sentences.zh: 丢失一个回复的干净 30 数据包 ping 显示连接行上有 59 个数据包且零丢弃，这两个数字都是正确的：发出 30 个请求，返回 29 个回复，并且该工具没有破坏任何一个。

sentences.en: End-to-end loss is what your application's own figures (or ping's "Lost") are for.
sentences.zh: 端到端丢失是应用程序自己的数据（或 ping 的“丢失”）的用途。

blocks.html_en: • Save reproduction report - a single JSON file with the lot: seed, all settings, counters, metrics, event log, connections and a ready CLI command that recreates the conditions. It also records the WinDivert queue the session ran behind (session.driver_queue: length, time and size). That is the driver's own buffer, ahead of this tool's: with the default 2000 ms queue time a packet can wait in it, and that wait lands on your latency without appearing in any counter here. A report from a machine you do not have in front of you now says which queue produced its numbers. The same three values go into the log at START.

blocks.html_en: The seed guarantees identical per-packet decisions for the same packet sequence. sentences.en: Scenario file format
sentences.zh: 场景文件格式

blocks.html_en: A scenario is a timeline: a list of steps, each with a time in seconds and what to do at that moment. The file is JSON, either an object or a bare list of steps:

sentences.en: A scenario is a timeline: a list of steps, each with a time in seconds and what to do at that moment.
sentences.zh: 场景是一个时间线：一系列步骤，每个步骤都有一个以秒为单位的时间以及当时要做什么。

sentences.en: The file is JSON, either an object or a bare list of steps:
sentences.zh: 该文件是 JSON，可以是一个对象，也可以是一个简单的步骤列表：

sentences.en: File level

sentences.en: meaning

sentences.en: required - the list of steps.

sentences.en: A bare [ ... ] at the top level works too, and means loop: false.
sentences.zh: 顶层的裸 [ ... ] 也可以工作，并且意味着loop: false。

blocks.html_en: optional, default false. Replays the timeline endlessly, restarting after the LAST step's at.

sentences.en: optional, default false.
sentences.zh: 可选，默认 false。

sentences.en: Replays the timeline endlessly, restarting after the LAST step's at.
sentences.zh: 无休止地重播时间线，在最后一步后重新开始。

blocks.html_en: Step level - a step needs settings, action, or both. One that has neither is an error, not a pause.

sentences.en: Step level - a step needs settings, action, or both.

blocks.html_en: Which names go in settings - any setting the tool has, under the same name as the config file (that is, its command-line flag with the dashes turned into underscores): loss, latency, jitter, down, up, buffer, spike_prob, flap_period, dst_ip, block_port, target, rate_schedule, max_size, nat_timeout, rst_prob, lan_mode, seed and the rest. Run --print-config to dump the full set of names with their current values.

sentences.en: Which names go in settings - any setting the tool has, under the same name as the config file (that is, its command-line flag with the dashes turned into underscores): loss, latency, jitter, down, up, buffer, spike_prob, flap_period, dst_ip, block_port, target, rate_schedule, max_size, nat_timeout, rst_prob, lan_mode, seed and the rest.
sentences.zh: 设置中的名称 - 工具具有的与配置文件同名的任何设置（即，其命令行标志中的破折号变成下划线）：loss、latency、jitter、down、up、buffer、spike_prob、flap_period、dst_ip、block_port、target、rate_schedule、max_size、nat_timeout、rst_prob、lan_mode、seed 等。

sentences.en: Run --print-config to dump the full set of names with their current values.
sentences.zh: 运行 --print-config 以转储完整的名称集及其当前值。

blocks.html_en: Everything is validated when the file loads, and a mistake names itself. An unknown setting, an unknown action, an unknown key, a duration that is not a number, a step that does nothing, a step list that is empty or longer than 1000 steps - each fails with a message pointing at the step number. This matters more than it sounds: a misspelled key used to be silent, so "duraton" quietly left the reset at its 3-second default and "lop" quietly turned looping off, and in both cases the tool looked like it was ignoring the file.

sentences.en: Everything is validated when the file loads, and a mistake names itself.
sentences.zh: 文件加载时，所有内容都会得到验证，并且错误会自行命名。

sentences.en: An unknown setting, an unknown action, an unknown key, a duration that is not a number, a step that does nothing, a step list that is empty or longer than 1000 steps - each fails with a message pointing at the step number.
sentences.zh: 未知的设置、未知的操作、未知的键、非数字的持续时间、不执行任何操作的步骤、为空或超过 1000 个步骤的步骤列表 - 每个步骤都会失败，并显示一条指向步骤编号的消息。

sentences.en: This matters more than it sounds: a misspelled key used to be silent, so "duraton" quietly left the reset at its 3-second default and "lop" quietly turned looping off, and in both cases the tool looked like it was ignoring the file.
sentences.zh: 这比听起来更重要：拼写错误的键曾经是无声的，因此“duraton”悄悄地将重置保留为 3 秒默认值，“lop”悄悄地关闭循环，在这两种情况下，该工具看起来都忽略了该文件。

blocks.html_en: Steps are applied by a timer that ticks every 0.1 s, so sub-second timings are honoured to about that much. --dry-run validates a --scenario without touching the driver, which makes it a cheap check in a pipeline.

sentences.en: Steps are applied by a timer that ticks every 0.1 s, so sub-second timings are honoured to about that much. --dry-run validates a --scenario without touching the driver, which makes it a cheap check in a pipeline.
sentences.zh: 步骤由每 0.1 秒滴答一次的计时器应用，因此亚秒级计时大约可以达到这个程度。 --dry-run 在不接触驱动程序的情况下验证 --scenario，这使得它成为管道中的廉价检查。

blocks.html_en: The tests run at 300 ms delay and 5% loss. The shaper stops itself after 120 s, so no "stuck" step leaves a broken network on the agent.

sentences.en: The tests run at 300 ms delay and 5% loss.
sentences.zh: 测试以 300 毫秒的延迟和 5% 的丢失运行。

sentences.en: Note: run the background process with --duration - it is the safety net.

blocks.html_en: Three deliberate build decisions (do not change them without need - each fixes a real bug):

sentences.en: Three deliberate build decisions (do not change them without need - each fixes a real bug):
sentences.zh: 三个经过深思熟虑的构建决策（如果没有必要，请勿更改它们 - 每个决策都修复了一个真正的错误）：

blocks.html_en: • console subsystem (not --noconsole): otherwise the exe has no stdout/stderr, and cmd.exe and PowerShell do not wait for a GUI process - CI would see neither output nor exit code. On GUI start the program detaches from the console itself, so a double-click leaves no black window.

sentences.en: console subsystem (not --noconsole): otherwise the exe has no stdout/stderr, and cmd.exe and PowerShell do not wait for a GUI process - CI would see neither output nor exit code.
sentences.zh: 控制台子系统（不是 --noconsole）：否则 exe 没有 stdout/stderr，并且 cmd.exe 和 PowerShell 不会等待 GUI 进程 - CI 既不会看到输出，也不会看到退出代码。

sentences.en: On GUI start the program detaches from the console itself, so a double-click leaves no black window.
sentences.zh: 在 GUI 启动时，程序与控制台本身分离，因此双击不会留下黑色窗口。

blocks.html_en: • onedir (not --onefile): pydivert carries WinDivert64.sys, and onefile unpacked it to %TEMP%\_MEIxxxx. The kernel holds an open handle to the loaded .sys, so the directory could not be deleted until a restart. In the directory build the driver sits next to the exe, on a stable path.

sentences.en: onedir (not --onefile): pydivert carries WinDivert64.sys, and onefile unpacked it to %TEMP%\_MEIxxxx.
sentences.zh: onedir（不是--onefile）：pydivert携带WinDivert64.sys，onefile将其解压到%TEMP%\_MEIxxxx。

sentences.en: The kernel holds an open handle to the loaded .sys, so the directory could not be deleted until a restart.
sentences.zh: 内核持有已加载的 .sys 的打开句柄，因此在重新启动之前无法删除该目录。

sentences.en: In the directory build the driver sits next to the exe, on a stable path.
sentences.zh: 在 build 目录中，驱动程序位于 exe 旁边的稳定路径上。

blocks.html_en: • asInvoker (not --uac-admin): requireAdministrator always creates a new process on elevation - losing the caller's pipes and exit code. Now the GUI asks for elevation itself, and the CLI ends with code 7 and a clear message when rights are missing (--simulate does not need them).

sentences.en: asInvoker (not --uac-admin): requireAdministrator always creates a new process on elevation - losing the caller's pipes and exit code.
sentences.zh: asInvoker（不是 --uac-admin）：requireAdministrator 总是在提升时创建一个新进程 - 丢失调用者的管道和退出代码。

sentences.en: Now the GUI asks for elevation itself, and the CLI ends with code 7 and a clear message when rights are missing (--simulate does not need them).
sentences.zh: 现在，GUI 本身要求提升权限，CLI 以代码 7 结尾，并在缺少权限时显示一条明确的消息（--simulate 不需要它们）。

blocks.html_en: The icon can be regenerated with a Pillow script (pip install pillow), but Pillow is not needed for normal operation.

sentences.en: The icon can be regenerated with a Pillow script (pip install pillow), but Pillow is not needed for normal operation.
sentences.zh: 可以使用 Pillow 脚本（pip installpillow）重新生成图标，但正常操作不需要 Pillow。

blocks.html_en: Gotchas (read before filing a bug)

sentences.en: Gotchas (read before filing a bug)
sentences.zh: 陷阱（在提交错误之前阅读）

blocks.html_en: • --duration is a safety net, not just convenience. Without it a session lasts until Ctrl+C / STOP. In CI always pass --duration. The one exception is a scenario with a timeline: --scenario with a file that does not loop and has more than one step now ends the run when the scenario ends, and says so at the start. A looping or single-step scenario has no end to stop at, so it warns and keeps going until you stop it.

sentences.en: --duration is a safety net, not just convenience.
sentences.zh: ——持续时间是一个安全网，而不仅仅是便利。

sentences.en: Without it a session lasts until Ctrl+C / STOP.
sentences.zh: 如果没有它，会话将持续到 Ctrl+C / STOP。

sentences.en: In CI always pass --duration.
sentences.zh: 在 CI 中总是传递 --duration。

sentences.en: The one exception is a scenario with a timeline: --scenario with a file that does not loop and has more than one step now ends the run when the scenario ends, and says so at the start.
sentences.zh: 一个例外是带有时间线的场景： --scenario 的文件不循环且具有多个步骤，现在会在场景结束时结束运行，并在开始时如此说明。

sentences.en: A looping or single-step scenario has no end to stop at, so it warns and keeps going until you stop it.
sentences.zh: 循环或单步场景没有终点，因此它会发出警告并继续运行，直到您停止为止。

blocks.html_en: • No traffic = a green run. If the filter catches not a single packet, the program works correctly and exits with code 0. Want that to be an error -> --fail-on-no-traffic.

sentences.en: No traffic = a green run.
sentences.zh: 没有交通=绿色运行。

sentences.en: If the filter catches not a single packet, the program works correctly and exits with code 0.
sentences.zh: 如果过滤器没有捕获到任何数据包，则程序将正常工作并以代码 0 退出。

sentences.en: Want that to be an error -> --fail-on-no-traffic.
sentences.zh: 希望这是一个错误 -> --fail-on-no-traffic。

blocks.html_en: • The traffic filter and duration take effect only from START (as in the GUI): "Apply changes" does not touch them.

sentences.en: The traffic filter and duration take effect only from START (as in the GUI): "Apply changes" does not touch them.
sentences.zh: 流量过滤器和持续时间仅从开始时生效（如在 GUI 中）：“应用更改”不会影响它们。

blocks.html_en: • After STOP the packets waiting in the delay queue are dropped. At --latency 5000 that can be quite a few packets at once - this is not a leak, it is the end of the session.

sentences.en: After STOP the packets waiting in the delay queue are dropped.
sentences.zh: STOP 后，延迟队列中等待的数据包将被丢弃。

sentences.en: At --latency 5000 that can be quite a few packets at once - this is not a leak, it is the end of the session.
sentences.zh: 在 --latency 5000 时，可能会同时产生相当多的数据包 - 这不是泄漏，而是会话结束。

blocks.html_en: • The speed limit has a buffer (--buffer, default 1000 ms). With an offered load above the limit, once the buffer fills the excess goes as "Rate-limit drop" (a separate counter) - this is clogged-link behaviour, not a bug. Raising the limit mid-session takes effect only after the buffer drains (up to ~--buffer ms). Want the old unbounded buffer (packets instead of drops, at the cost of growing delay)? Set --buffer 0.

sentences.en: The speed limit has a buffer (--buffer, default 1000 ms).
sentences.zh: 速度限制有一个缓冲区（--buffer，默认1000毫秒）。

sentences.en: With an offered load above the limit, once the buffer fills the excess goes as "Rate-limit drop" (a separate counter) - this is clogged-link behaviour, not a bug.
sentences.zh: 当提供的负载超过限制时，一旦缓冲区填满，超出的部分就会成为“速率限制下降”（一个单独的计数器）——这是链路堵塞行为，而不是错误。

sentences.en: Raising the limit mid-session takes effect only after the buffer drains (up to ~--buffer ms).
sentences.zh: 仅在缓冲区耗尽后（最多 ~--buffer ms），在会话中提高限制才会生效。

sentences.en: Want the old unbounded buffer (packets instead of drops, at the cost of growing delay)?
sentences.zh: 想要旧的无界缓冲区（数据包而不是丢弃，以增加延迟为代价）？

sentences.en: Set --buffer 0.
sentences.zh: 设置--缓冲区0。

blocks.html_en: • --dst-port "!53" also catches traffic with no port (e.g. ICMP): a packet with no port "is not port 53".

sentences.en: --dst-port "!53" also catches traffic with no port (e.g. ICMP): a packet with no port "is not port 53".
sentences.zh: --dst-port "!53" 还捕获没有端口的流量（例如 ICMP）：没有端口的数据包“不是端口 53”。

blocks.html_en: • A bare process name is a substring: --target chrome also catches chromedriver.exe. Precisely: --target "re:^chrome\.exe$".

sentences.en: A bare process name is a substring: --target chrome also catches chromedriver.exe.
sentences.zh: 裸进程名称是一个子字符串：--target chrome 还捕获 chromedriver.exe。

sentences.en: Precisely: --target "re:^chrome\.exe$".
sentences.zh: 准确地说：--target“re:^chrome\.exe$”。

blocks.html_en: • Ranges are inclusive on both ends (80-80 = one port), as in nmap/iptables.

sentences.en: Ranges are inclusive on both ends (80-80 = one port), as in nmap/iptables.
sentences.zh: 范围包括两端（80-80 = 一个端口），如 nmap/iptables 中一样。

blocks.html_en: • The CLI is always in English, regardless of GUI and system language.

sentences.en: The CLI is always in English, regardless of GUI and system language.
sentences.zh: 无论 GUI 和系统语言如何，CLI 始终为英语。

blocks.html_en: • -q really is quiet: on success it prints nothing. Read the result from the exit code (or add --format json).

sentences.en: -q really is quiet: on success it prints nothing.
sentences.zh: -q 确实很安静：成功时它什么也不打印。

sentences.en: Read the result from the exit code (or add --format json).
sentences.zh: 从退出代码中读取结果（或添加 --format json）。

blocks.html_en: • Running without admin (and without --simulate) ends with code 7 - not "silence".

sentences.en: Running without admin (and without --simulate) ends with code 7 - not "silence".
sentences.zh: 在没有 admin（并且没有 --simulate）的情况下运行以代码 7 结束 - 而不是“沉默”。

blocks.html_en: • The driver locked a file in %TEMP%? That is a relic of old onefile builds: BeanNetworkTester.exe --cleanup-driver frees it without a system restart.

sentences.en: The driver locked a file in %TEMP%?
sentences.zh: 驱动程序锁定了 %TEMP% 中的文件？

sentences.en: That is a relic of old onefile builds: BeanNetworkTester.exe --cleanup-driver frees it without a system restart.
sentences.zh: 这是旧的 onefile 构建的遗留物：BeanNetworkTester.exe --cleanup-driver 无需重新启动系统即可释放它。

blocks.html_en: The engine is separate from WinDivert, so the tests run on any system (they need neither Windows, admin nor tkinter). The suite is based on pytest:

sentences.en: The engine is separate from WinDivert, so the tests run on any system (they need neither Windows, admin nor tkinter).
sentences.zh: 该引擎与 WinDivert 是分开的，因此测试可以在任何系统上运行（它们既不需要 Windows、admin 也不需要 tkinter）。

sentences.en: The suite is based on pytest:
sentences.zh: 该套件基于 pytest：

blocks.html_en: They cover every mechanism: loss, latency, jitter, per-direction throttling, corruption, duplication, filter expressions (lists, ranges, !, >, <, wildcards, re:, CIDR, IPv6), process/destination targeting, SYN dropping, MTU, flapping, NAT expiry, RST injection, latency spikes, the schedule, the connection log, repeatability (seed), scenarios, the config file, the summary (PL/EN), UI translations and reproduction (effective seed, event log, report and CLI command). A separate test also runs the GUI smoke (smoke_gui.py, on a fake tkinter), and repo conventions (naming, no tkinter in the core package, allowed layering) are guarded by tests.

sentences.en: They cover every mechanism: loss, latency, jitter, per-direction throttling, corruption, duplication, filter expressions (lists, ranges, !, >, <, wildcards, re:, CIDR, IPv6), process/destination targeting, SYN dropping, MTU, flapping, NAT expiry, RST injection, latency spikes, the schedule, the connection log, repeatability (seed), scenarios, the config file, the summary (PL/EN), UI translations and reproduction (effective seed, event log, report and CLI command).
sentences.zh: 它们涵盖了所有机制：丢失、延迟、抖动、单向节流、损坏、重复、过滤表达式（列表、范围、!、>、<、通配符、re:、CIDR、IPv6）、进程/目标定位、SYN 丢弃、MTU、抖动、NAT 过期、RST 注入、延迟峰值、时间表、连接日志、可重复性（种子）、场景、配置文件、摘要 (PL/EN)、UI翻译和复制（有效种子、事件日志、报告和 CLI 命令）。

sentences.en: A separate test also runs the GUI smoke (smoke_gui.py, on a fake tkinter), and repo conventions (naming, no tkinter in the core package, allowed layering) are guarded by tests.
sentences.zh: 单独的测试还运行 GUI 烟雾（smoke_gui.py，在假 tkinter 上），并且存储库约定（命名、核心包中没有 tkinter、允许分层）由测试保护。

blocks.html_en: The CI/CD CLI contract is guarded separately:

sentences.en: The CI/CD CLI contract is guarded separately:
sentences.zh: CI/CD CLI 合约是单独保护的：

blocks.html_en: • tests/test_cli_runtime.py - exit codes (0/1/3/4/5/6/130/143), --duration accuracy (not "to the nearest report"), stdout/stderr separation, NDJSON, -q/-v, --dry-run, --print-config, --min-packets, --duration precedence over the config file. The reporting loop gets an injected clock, so duration tests run in microseconds.

sentences.en: tests/test_cli_runtime.py - exit codes (0/1/3/4/5/6/130/143), --duration accuracy (not "to the nearest report"), stdout/stderr separation, NDJSON, -q/-v, --dry-run, --print-config, --min-packets, --duration precedence over the config file.
sentences.zh: tests/test_cli_runtime.py - 退出代码 (0/1/3/4/5/6/130/143)、--duration 准确性（不是“到最近的报告”）、stdout/stderr 分离、NDJSON、-q/-v、--dry-run、--print-config、--min-packets、--duration 优先于配置文件。

sentences.en: The reporting loop gets an injected clock, so duration tests run in microseconds.
sentences.zh: 报告循环获取注入时钟，因此持续时间测试以微秒为单位运行。

blocks.html_en: • tests/test_failsafe.py - the session stops itself after duration, a dead capture thread causes a fail-open (releasing the driver = network returns), the GUI _tick survives an exception, the targeting thread never touches tkinter, closing the window always releases the engine.

sentences.en: tests/test_failsafe.py - the session stops itself after duration, a dead capture thread causes a fail-open (releasing the driver = network returns), the GUI _tick survives an exception, the targeting thread never touches tkinter, closing the window always releases the engine.
sentences.zh: test/test_failsafe.py - 会话在持续时间后自行停止，死捕获线程导致失败打开（释放驱动程序 = 网络返回），GUI _tick 在异常中幸存，目标线程永远不会接触 tkinter，关闭窗口总是释放引擎。

blocks.html_en: GitHub Actions runs the same tests on every push (.github/workflows/ci.yml), on a Linux + Windows matrix: the suite behind a coverage gate, the GUI smoke on the fake tkinter, exit-code assertions, an NDJSON check, --doctor and --license, and then an .exe build with a smoke test of the built file (--version, --simulate, a bad config -> code 3) plus a check that the WinDivert driver really shipped next to the exe, with a downloadable artifact.

sentences.en: GitHub Actions runs the same tests on every push (.github/workflows/ci.yml), on a Linux + Windows matrix: the suite behind a coverage gate, the GUI smoke on the fake tkinter, exit-code assertions, an NDJSON check, --doctor and --license, and then an .exe build with a smoke test of the built file (--version, --simulate, a bad config -> code 3) plus a check that the WinDivert driver really shipped next to the exe, with a downloadable artifact.
sentences.zh: GitHub Actions 在 Linux + Windows 矩阵上对每次推送 (.github/workflows/ci.yml) 运行相同的测试：覆盖门后面的套件、假 tkinter 上的 GUI 冒烟、退出代码断言、NDJSON 检查、--doctor 和 --license，然后使用构建文件的冒烟测试进行 .exe 构建（--version、--simulate、错误配置 -> 代码 3），并检查 WinDivert 驱动程序是否确实在旁边发布exe，带有可下载的工件。

Polish labels are longer than English ones, so that is where layouts break, and it has caught breakage that was invisible in English.

blocks.html_en: The core BeanCore.decide() is a pure function that decides a packet's fate in order: targeting -> LAN mode -> blocking (firewall) -> NAT -> RST -> flapping -> MTU -> SYN -> loss -> corruption -> delay/jitter/spike -> throughput limit (a token bucket with a bounded buffer, optionally from the schedule) -> duplication. The capture thread reads packets and runs the decision. The re-inject thread sends them at the chosen moment. All randomness goes through one generator (optionally seeded).

sentences.en: The core BeanCore.decide() is a pure function that decides a packet's fate in order: targeting -> LAN mode -> blocking (firewall) -> NAT -> RST -> flapping -> MTU -> SYN -> loss -> corruption -> delay/jitter/spike -> throughput limit (a token bucket with a bounded buffer, optionally from the schedule) -> duplication.
sentences.zh: 核心 BeanCore.decide() 是一个纯函数，按顺序决定数据包的命运：目标 -> LAN 模式 -> 阻塞（防火墙） -> NAT -> RST -> 抖动 -> MTU -> SYN -> 丢失 -> 损坏 -> 延迟/抖动/尖峰 -> 吞吐量限制（具有有界缓冲区的令牌桶，可选地来自调度）-> 复制。

sentences.en: The capture thread reads packets and runs the decision.
sentences.zh: 捕获线程读取数据包并运行决策。

sentences.en: The re-inject thread sends them at the chosen moment.
sentences.zh: 重新注入线程在选定的时刻发送它们。

sentences.en: All randomness goes through one generator (optionally seeded).
sentences.zh: 所有随机性都通过一台生成器（可选种子）。

blocks.html_en: • Process targeting is driven by socket events, not a slow poll. WinDivert hands us a packet, not a PID, so we map a packet to its process by local port. On Windows the tool watches the system's socket events (connect / bind / accept / close) as they happen, so a new connection or UDP flow of a program that is already in scope is impaired from its very first packet - that covers DNS queries and QUIC, each of which takes a fresh port. The exception is the program's first connection: until it owns at least one socket there is nothing to recognise it by, so that one connection goes through untouched. Without real WinDivert (the test / simulation path) it falls back to scanning the socket table a few times a second, where the first packet of any brand-new connection can slip through. Either way the watching runs on its own thread, never on the one handling your packets, so it can never turn into lost traffic.

blocks.html_en: • If the program under test restarts, aim by NAME, not by process id. Measured: a target that exits and comes back under a new process id is picked up again by itself, and the restart costs exactly one connection - the one it opens before it owns any socket. blocks.html_en: • An exclusion on its own also covers everything the tool cannot identify. !chrome in the process field means "impair everything except chrome" - and "everything" includes any connection whose owning process could not be determined: protected system processes the tool cannot open, and - on the polling fallback - the first packets of a brand-new socket. So do not use an exclusion to protect an application. If you want one app left alone, name the app you DO want broken (--target thatapp) - then anything unidentified passes through untouched, which is the safe direction. This mirrors !53 on ports, below.

blocks.html_en:
• Statistics and Connections show ALL captured traffic by default - whatever the "Traffic to modify" filter passes. Targeting (process / IP / port) decides only what gets broken, not what is visible in the tables and counters. Two switches in Settings, in the "Scope" card, change that, and they are not the same thing:

    • "Show only the targeted traffic" narrows the counters, the throughput chart, the Connections table and the connections CSV to what your targeting selected. It changes what you SEE - never what is captured, never what is impaired, and you can flip it at any time.
    • "Capture only the targeted traffic" narrows the capture itself: the driver stops handing over anything but your destination's traffic, so the tabs cover that traffic because there is nothing else to cover. It is fixed when the session starts, and it only works for a destination the driver's filter language can express - a plain address, a list, a range or a CIDR. A wildcard, an re: pattern or targeting only a process cannot be pushed down, and then the option does nothing. The Scope card says which of the two you are getting before you press START, the log says it again at start, and the Session panel's "Capture" row records it for the run.

    Whichever is on, the note above the counters and above the Connections table says what those figures actually cover, including the case where the capture is narrowed and a process target is set - the tool then captures your destination's traffic from every process and impairs one process's share, so the counters cover more than the impairment does. Three counters stay on the full traffic even with "Show only" on: "Queue overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" count packets this tool lost, including traffic you never targeted, and hiding those would hide the tool's own damage. The statistics CSV does not follow the "Show only" switch either - it is an append log, so it carries both totals in separate columns - but it does record "Capture only" per row in capture_narrowed, because that one changes what was counted at all. The reproduction report and --format json always carry both numbers.

blocks.html_en: Whichever is on, the note above the counters and above the Connections table says what those figures actually cover, including the case where the capture is narrowed and a process target is set - the tool then captures your destination's traffic from every process and impairs one process's share, so the counters cover more than the impairment does. Three counters stay on the full traffic even with "Show only" on: "Queue overflow", "Dropped at stop" and "Send failed" count packets this tool lost, including traffic you never targeted, and hiding those would hide the tool's own damage. The statistics CSV does not follow the "Show only" switch either - it is an append log, so it carries both totals in separate columns - but it does record "Capture only" per row in capture_narrowed, because that one changes what was counted at all. The reproduction report and --format json always carry both numbers.

blocks.html_en: • A failure mid-session always ends with the network restored - if the capture thread dies, the engine STOPs itself and releases the driver (fail-open), instead of holding an open handle no one reaches (this was a real path to "the user suddenly has no internet"). The reason goes to the log and the event log.

sentences.en: A failure mid-session always ends with the network restored - if the capture thread dies, the engine STOPs itself and releases the driver (fail-open), instead of holding an open handle no one reaches (this was a real path to "the user suddenly has no internet").
sentences.zh: 会话中的故障总是以网络恢复结束 - 如果捕获线程死亡，引擎会自行停止并释放驱动程序（故障打开），而不是持有无人到达的打开句柄（这是“用户突然没有互联网”的真正路径）。

sentences.en: The reason goes to the log and the event log.
sentences.zh: 原因在于日志和事件日志。

blocks.html_en: • Closing the program releases the WinDivert driver - not after every session (a session restart should be instant), but once, on exit. As long as the driver is loaded, the kernel holds the WinDivert64.sys sitting next to the exe open - and then the program directory cannot be removed, even when it looks empty (Windows lets you delete a file with an open handle: it vanishes from the list but stays in pending delete and blocks the directory). If something is left over, the rescue without a restart is BeanNetworkTester.exe --cleanup-driver (or sc stop WinDivert + sc delete WinDivert).

blocks.html_en: The LGPL libraries can be replaced with your own interface-compatible versions, and the two are replaced differently. WinDivert is a DLL and a driver loaded from disk at run time, so you swap the files in _internal\pydivert\windivert_dll\ - which is why the program is built as onedir rather than as a single file. PyDivert is pure Python and is compiled into the .exe, so it is replaced by rebuilding the program against your version, or by running it from source. Dropping a modified copy next to the .exe does not work, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md says so rather than leaving you to find out. GPLv3 is compatible with these components' licenses, and nothing in the project's license restricts the rights arising from them.

blocks.html_en: Bean Network Tester sends no data anywhere. It has no telemetry, no update checks and no network client of any kind. The tool captures network traffic on your computer - and that data never leaves it. The only outbound connection the program can make is opening the support page in your browser, and only when you click the corresponding button yourself.

sentences.zh: 它没有遥测、没有更新检查，也没有任何类型的网络客户端。

sentences.en: The tool captures network traffic on your computer - and that data never leaves it.
sentences.zh: 该工具捕获您计算机上的网络流量 - 并且该数据永远不会离开它。

sentences.en: The only outbound connection the program can make is opening the support page in your browser, and only when you click the corresponding button yourself.
sentences.zh: 该程序可以建立的唯一出站连接是在浏览器中打开支持页面，并且仅当您自己单击相应的按钮时。

blocks.html_en: A note on SmartScreen and antivirus

sentences.en: A note on SmartScreen and antivirus
sentences.zh: 关于 SmartScreen 和防病毒软件的说明

blocks.html_en: The .exe is not (yet) signed with a certificate, and at the same time it asks for administrator rights and loads a network driver - so Windows SmartScreen may show an "Unknown publisher" warning, and some antivirus tools may raise a false alarm. The WinDivert driver itself is digitally signed by its author. You can compare the release's SHA-256 checksum (SHA256SUMS.txt) to confirm the file has not been modified.

sentences.en: The .exe is not (yet) signed with a certificate, and at the same time it asks for administrator rights and loads a network driver - so Windows SmartScreen may show an "Unknown publisher" warning, and some antivirus tools may raise a false alarm.
sentences.zh: 该 .exe 尚未使用证书进行签名，同时它会请求管理员权限并加载网络驱动程序 - 因此 Windows SmartScreen 可能会显示“未知发布者”警告，并且某些防病毒工具可能会发出误报。

sentences.en: The WinDivert driver itself is digitally signed by its author.
sentences.zh: WinDivert 驱动程序本身已由其作者进行数字签名。
